capabilities: Indexes note names and aliases for autocomplete
Answers title, property, tag and unlinked-mention lookups
Records heading times and block metadata
Publishes a versioned API for other plugins
extras: Aimed at large vaults; ships an interactive demo vault; API reference in docs/api.md; derived caches stay per-device while heading history and registered property names sync through ordinary vault files.
intentEvidence: replacing the method that already asks the question, so nothing has to know the plugin is installed
problem: Obsidian answers several vault-wide questions with no index behind them, so backlinks, name autocomplete and property lookups rescan every note on every call and feel slow on large vaults.

relations.evidence: Supersedes Backlink Cache: includes its backlink index
Same approach for different core lookups: metadata calls, not full-text search
The handle comes from the @mnaoumov/obsidian-lib plugin registry
frontmatter markdown links when Frontmatter Markdown Links is installed

summary: Vault-index plugin that maintains backlink, name, title, property and tag indexes so Obsidian's built-in lookups and plugin calls stop rescanning every note.
